```bash
echo "COOKIE=$COOKIE"
```

**Step 2: Hit EVERY authenticated page and check status + errors**
```bash
for path in \
  /dashboard \
  /calendar \
  /appointments /appointments/new \
  /waitlist \
  /clients /clients/new \
  /consent-forms \
  /ai-design \
  /artists \
  /guest-artists \
  /inventory /inventory/stocktake \
  /commissions /commissions/records /commissions/rules /commissions/adjustments /commissions/disputes \
  /payroll \
  /payments \
  /locations \
  /marketing \
  /reports /reports/revenue /reports/artists /reports/clients /reports/bookings /reports/inventory /reports/ai \
  /settings /settings/billing /settings/team /settings/services /settings/branding /settings/booking-page /settings/integrations /settings/tags /settings/profile \
  /admin /admin/studios /admin/billing /admin/ai-usage /admin/system \
; do
  result=$(curl -s -b "$COOKIE" -o /tmp/page_out.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:3100$path" 2>&1)
  errors=$(grep -oiE 'Internal Server Error|application error|Error:|Unhandled Runtime Error|500|Cannot read prop|undefined is not|TypeError|ReferenceError' /tmp/page_out.html 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  has_content=$(grep -c '<main\|<div.*class\|data-slot' /tmp/page_out.html 2>/dev/null)
  if [ "$result" = "500" ] || [ -n "$errors" ]; then
    echo "BROKEN  $result $path: $errors"
  elif [ "$result" = "307" ]; then
    redirect=$(grep -o 'location:[^ ]*' /tmp/page_out.html 2>/dev/null || echo "redirect")
    echo "REDIRECT $result $path → $redirect"
  elif [ "$has_content" -lt 3 ]; then
    echo "EMPTY   $result $path (minimal content)"
  else
    echo "OK      $result $path"
  fi
done
```
